cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: For the Record
cards.instruction: Get someone to state exactly what they did, knew, or authorized before you reveal your own involvement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Before I show you the fireworks invoice, exactly what did you approve?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did you buy the enormous rocket?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. First, did your 'make it memorable' include rockets?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It included sparklers. Nothing that needed a trailer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When did you first mention the trailer limit? I need that date before we get to the delivery date.

mechanism: A turns its pupil vague fireworks approval into a coached precise record, demanding scope and timing before revealing its own purchase.
confusable: Not merely checking a form: A withholds the invoice and follows new limits with another exact question about when they were authorized.
comparison: Purchase authorization versus invitations and prior exclusion message.
